name: launch-and-own
description: Build customer-owned static websites with secure GitHub and Cloudflare linking, exact preview, separate human approval and verified publication via Launch & Own.

interface.longDescription: Prepare a customer-owned website in ChatGPT, connect GitHub and Cloudflare through a secure browser flow, review the exact site and separately approve publication. A verified live release is required before it is called published.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan and build a website I own.
Prepare a simple website and show me the approval steps.
Check the publication status of my Launch & Own website.
